title: Kite Clash: Rooftop Kites
short: Rooftop kite fighting! Cut rival kites, collect kites & join the weekly league.
full:
Fly your kite over the city rooftops and cut every rival kite in the sky. Kite Clash is a quick, colourful kite-fighting game inspired by festival kite flying.

HOW TO PLAY
• Move your kite with one finger.
• Touch a rival kite's string with your string to cut it.
• Keep your own string away from theirs, or your kite gets cut.
• Clear the goal of each level, then face the Golden Kite in boss levels.

FEATURES
• Endless levels that slowly get harder, with morning, noon, golden-hour, sunset and night skies.
• Combos: cut kites one after another for bonus coins and points.
• Power-ups in the sky: Razor String and shields.
• Shop: collect 12 kite designs and 6 kinds of string, and buy shields that protect you at the start of each level.
• Weekly League: every kite you cut and every level you clear earns points. Each week the top 3 players win gold, silver and bronze badges, which are counted on your profile.
• Play in English or Urdu.
• Works offline (the league needs an internet connection).

GOOD TO KNOW
• The game is free to play and shows ads (a banner and occasional full-screen ads between levels).
• Optional rewarded videos give you double coins or a second chance. Watching them is always your choice.
• Optional in-app purchases: Remove Ads, and coin packs. Everything in the game can also be earned by playing.

اردو میں
کائٹ کلیش میں شہر کی چھتوں پر پتنگ اڑائیں اور آسمان کی ہر پتنگ کاٹ دیں۔ انگلی سے اپنی پتنگ چلائیں، دوسروں کی ڈور کاٹیں اور اپنی ڈور بچائیں۔ دکان سے نئی پتنگیں اور مانجھے لیں، اور ہفتہ وار لیگ میں ٹاپ 3 میں آ کر سونے، چاندی اور کانسی کے بیج جیتیں۔ گیم مفت ہے، اس میں ایڈز ہیں، اور ایڈز ہٹانے یا سکے لینے کے لیے اختیاری خریداری بھی موجود ہے۔
notes: 12 kite designs (SKINS array) and 6 strings (STRINGS array) per index.html. Coin packs: Coin Pouch 2,500 coins, Coin Chest 12,000 coins.
